sources.title: Reese Harvey and H. Blaine Lawson Jr., Calibrated geometries, Acta Mathematica 148 (1982), 47-157
sources.locations: Printed p.68, Question6.5 and equation6.6; local extraction and rendered page, public archive PDF opened.

sources.title: Hamza Fawzi, The set of separable states has no finite semidefinite representation except in dimension 3x2, Communications in Mathematical Physics 386 (2021), 1319-1335
sources.locations: Printed pp.1319–1321: normalized state definition, projected-lift definition, Theorem1 and application remarks. Local extracted text and public PDF inspected; rendered p.1321 viewed.
sources.claim: The definition allows arbitrary projected finite Hermitian LMIs and the theorem applies to Sep(3,3), hence also excludes real-symmetric lifts.
